who.value: app user who hasn't necessarily shopped for services

job.value: Notice a promoted service category and either explore it or dismiss

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Reliable Service. Unbeatable Price.' with 'Painting Service — from S$180' says this is a painting service promo.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: 'Explore Painting Service' is the only button, teal on orange, centred under the headline.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Explore Painting Service' says it opens that service, and the X in the corner closes.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: It asks only whether to explore painting or not, which anyone can decide.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: No detail is shown beyond the price-from line; providers are behind the button.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: A full-screen promo fits a launch moment, but painting is pushed to every launching user regardless of whether they're looking for services.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: A headline, one line and a button — readable at a glance.
